protocol.baseline: Original v3 global residual, original input features and timing propagation; archived three checkpoints, never retrained
protocol.single_change: Replace the original fitting-dominated objective by bounded true-gap-weighted pairwise logistic loss; use this same loss for the existing minimum-development-loss checkpoint rule
protocol.formula: s=0.01*D_original; w_ij=min(abs(y_i-y_j)/s,1); L=mean_{true-distinct pairs}(w_ij*softplus(-sign(y_i-y_j)*(p_i-p_j)/s)). p and y are maximum PO arrivals. Empty pair set returns differentiable zero.
protocol.weight_reduction: Divide by number of true-distinct pairs, not sum of weights. Thus a nearly-flat domain retains small gradients instead of renormalizing tiny gaps to full weight. Existing per-domain sample counts and equal circuit averaging remain unchanged.
protocol.tie_grouping: Same minimum-anchored bounded-width equivalence classes as ranking_evaluation/PROTOCOL.json, applied to detached true labels. Predicted ties are not masked: they must receive a learning gradient for truly distinct pairs.
protocol.outlier_control: True-gap weights saturate at 1 once gap reaches 1 percent of the original delay. Stable softplus bounds logit-gradient magnitude; original parameter gradient clipping remains 5. No absolute-regression auxiliary term or tunable mixing coefficient.
protocol.domain_policy: Use the same original prepared sampled and historical domains. Compare only combinations within each circuit and domain. Each historical domain has one record, so contributes zero pair loss; retain the existing sample-count factor 8/9 for sampled domains. Do not pair different catalogues or insert a synthetic original/no-op label.
unchanged: PO anchor and differentiable timing propagation
seeded initial parameters and circuit shuffle

data_roles.train: Original 12 training circuits; only these update weights
data_roles.development: Same previously inspected 12 circuits and eight frozen sampled combinations, also used by checkpoint selection
data_roles.independent: None this round; no new ABC Mapping authorized

protocol.severe_reversal: True gap exceeds 5 percent of that circuit's minimum true delay in the eight-combination domain and actual ranks differ. Report wrong pairs and predicted ties separately.
protocol.success_rule: Recommend independent confirmation only if every seed improves pairwise accuracy; aggregate Top1 does not fall; every seed's mean regret does not rise and aggregate mean strictly falls; pooled maximum regret does not rise; severe reversals do not increase; no new circuit-seed regret crosses above 5 percent from a baseline at or below 5 percent. Otherwise explicitly report tradeoffs or failure. This engineering decision rule is not a significance test.
protocol.failure_policy: One loss design and three runs only. No favorable-seed selection, post-hoc weight/tolerance changes, extra epochs or second loss variant. Diagnose remaining limitations without launching another fit.
protocol.interpretation: Outputs retain ps units and the original forward formula, but this objective does not calibrate absolute candidate delays. Ranking comparisons do not establish independent generalization; original serialized-noop confounding remains.
